bd_lines.148: Forthright is a certified partner of Building Dignity. Every worker on our projects is paid fairly and treated with respect — we hold our trade partners to the same standard.

bd_lines.229: Every worker on a Forthright project is treated well and paid fairly. We're a Building Dignity certified partner — it's a commitment we take seriously.
bd_lines.252: Forthright is a certified partner of Building Dignity, a Vermont organization that advocates for fair wages and safe conditions for workers in the building trades.
